Download the DMG below, open it and drag Lunetta to Applications.

This build is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so it opens without clearing the quarantine flag.

If you used a dev build before, macOS asks for Screen Recording again the first time you capture: the signing identity changed, so the old grant no longer matches. Allow it once in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording (and Microphone, if you record it), then quit and reopen Lunetta.
